title: fix(formula)!: refuse timestamp() over a date-only field, which faults on every row
body:
Fixes #34363

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #34450 (`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, the built-ins line listing `timestamp(s)`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：公式校验门（`validateExpression` / `validateStackExpressions`）现在把 `timestamp(record.DATE_FIELD)`（含 `+ duration(...)` 运算里的写法）判为错误，并提示改写为 `isoDate(addDays(record.DATE_FIELD, N))`；沿用既有的 `date-text-call` 系列错误码，未新增错误码。
- 为什么改：日期字段在运行时是 `YYYY-MM-DD` 文本，`timestamp()` 只认完整时间戳文本，所以这种写法校验通过、每次运行都失败，字段永远为空（cloud 侧 staging 实测过）。
- 风险与回滚：收窄了作者可写的表达式（BREAKING，按 minor 发布）；只拦日期型字段，日期时间型字段不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`（`firstDateTextCall` 新增的 `timestamp` 分支）、`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`（`shift` 子句与日期字段集合的传递）、`.changeset/34363-formula-timestamp-date-only.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts -t "timestamp"`，预期 6 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无。流程值槽位（`update_record` / `create_record` / `assignment` 的值表达式）未按字段类型校验，cloud#4717 那条表达式正写在这里，本 PR 未覆盖；已由 #34451 承接（p2，席位建议路线 A，非裁决；待点名时与 B/C 一并交维护者）。

## What changes

`timestamp(s)` is CEL's string overload. The date-text call check (`firstDateTextCall`), which declares a date field as the text the runtime holds, therefore checked `timestamp(record.borrow_date)` clean, while the evaluator faults on a `date` field's `YYYY-MM-DD` text on every row (`timestamp() requires a string in ISO 8601 format`; `timestamp(null)` finds no overload).

- `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`: `firstDateTextCall` takes the set of `date` (not `datetime`) fields and reports `timestamp(FIELD)` over one of them, with `date(FIELD)` as the rewrite (there is no `timestamp(google.protobuf.Timestamp)` overload to wrap for, so the parse replaces the call; the rewrite is checked clean before it is prescribed) and `shift` = `isoDate(addDays(FIELD, N))`. The early "whole expression checks clean" return now applies only when no date-only field is in reach, and the existing no-matching-overload arm runs only where the whole expression faulted, as before.
- `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`: the date-only field set is derived from the raw field types (flow-variable-shadowed names excluded) and threaded through `dateTextIssue` / `dateTextCallIssue`; the message gains the optional clause `To shift it by N whole days and keep it a date, write isoDate(addDays(FIELD, N)).`
- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal.ts`: `DateTextCallParams` gains the optional `shift` param, present exactly when the message carries that clause (the contract's optional-clause rule). No new code: the verdict rides `date-text-call` and its four outcome arms, the ruling's preferred route.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.formula-timestamp-date-only-refused.ts`: the upgrade-guide entry the narrowing's ADR-0087 disposition registers.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`: a row in the build-time checks table teaching the `isoDate(addDays(…))` shift.

## Why

Ruling-ref 6919070524 (maintainer 「分两批点名放行,不改级别」, batch 1). The card measured the shape live on staging (cloud#4717): it passes every author-time door and fails every run.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` in the date-text harness: the cloud#4717 expression is refused (code, params, shift text) and faults in the evaluator; the bare call is refused and `timestamp(null)` faults; the taught `isoDate(addDays(record.borrow_date, N))` is clean and evaluates to `2026-11-23` / `2026-12-16` / `2026-10-31` for N = 7 / 30 / -16 over `2026-11-16`; CONTROL: `timestamp()` over a `datetime` field stays clean and evaluates; the flow and fail-closed arms; a shadowing flow variable is not the field.
- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: a second exact-message pin under `date-text-call` (the `shift` param and clause), and a sweep source reaching it.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`: `validateStackExpressions` refuses the formula field and a record-triggered flow's start condition, and leaves the `addDays` formula and the `datetime` formula clean.

## Acceptance notes

- **Faces (measured on this branch through `@objectstack/lint`'s `runStackExpressionPasses`):** `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` (no `runtimeWriteType`), the object save door (`runtimeWriteType: 'object'`) and the flow publish door (`runtimeWriteType: 'flow'`) now refuse `timestamp(DATE_FIELD)` wherever the expression is judged with the object's field types: formula fields, validation rules, field rule predicates, flow start / edge / `decision` conditions.
- **Not reached — the card's own site:** a flow VALUE envelope (`update_record` / `create_record` `fields.*`, `assignment` values) is validated without field types, by lint's `checkDeclaredValue` and by the engine's `valueEnvelopeRefusals` alike, so no date-text verdict reaches it. Measured: a record-triggered flow whose `update_record` writes `due_date` from `isoDate(timestamp(record.borrow_date) + duration('168h'))` yields zero findings from `validateStackExpressions` on this branch. Typing value envelopes would narrow the whole date-text family and the type-mismatch verdicts there at once, so it is reported to the seat as a decision, not built here. Carried by #34451; cloud's verify_build probe (cloud#4723) stays until #34451 lands, so the card's third Done-when moves to #34451.
- The engine's `registerFlow` schema-aware pass is advisory (warnings, never thrown), so it is not a refusing face.
- `main` red on `check:platform-checklist` (approver-resolution-matrix VARIANTS STALE) is main's and is not touched here.
